findings.text: 1. (a) is subordinate because *although* marks a concessive relation requiring a larger clause in ordinary standard prose.
findings.problem: "mark" may be used for a score

findings.text: | Phrase | under the old bridge | no finite clause |
| Independent clause | The rain stopped. | can stand as a sentence |
| Dependent clause | because the rain stopped | subordinate; needs a larger construction |
